metadata.title: A Long Walk To Vaccination Center
metadata.description:
I stay in a remote village in West Khasi Hills of Meghalaya and being in the remote village, access to education, healthcare and something as basic as ATM or banking requires trekking down the mountains for hours. 
In this video I show you my journey to the nearest PHC located at the base of the mountain to get my Covid vaccine. 

Music Credit: Music from www.bensound.com
